name: minimind
description: 🧠 两小时从 0 训出你的 64M 大模型。Train your own 64M LLM from scratch in 2 hours.
one_liner: A step-by-step kit that lets anyone train a tiny AI language model from scratch, for a few dollars of compute, to actually understand how the big ones work.
buyer: A corporate AI-literacy trainer or bootcamp that runs paid 'how LLMs really work' workshops for non-ML engineers and managers.
business_use_cases: A corporate trainer uses it as the hands-on lab exercise in a paid one-day 'how LLMs actually work' workshop for engineering teams.
A content creator builds a paid video course walking viewers through training their own tiny model with this repo.
A university continuing-education program licenses the curriculum into a short, practical AI-fundamentals course.

money_ideas.idea: Sell seats in a paid hands-on workshop built around this repo.
Run a paid video course or membership teaching it step by step.

steal_this: Turn the repo into a one-day workshop deck and sell three seats to local developers this weekend.
